verdict.rationale: Bento says every prompt change is versioned, diffable, and reversible, and that fixes ship in shadow mode and graduate to full traffic, so prompt versioning is a documented capability. Nothing documents a prompt registry or runtime fetch that lets a developer push prompt edits to production without a code deploy. Skills and rules are said to live in the repo as Markdown and YAML, which points toward shipping changes through code. Missing for 10: a documented no-code or runtime prompt deployment path, a prompt registry/fetch API, environment or label promotion for prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
